title: Mr. PinPin / book-only input and one-view video
reviewNotes: 105 nominal degrees: repeated front-paw motion, not one complete four-legged gait. 120 nominal degrees: paw-to-chin gesture with largely static hind legs. Generated anchor anatomy was itself unapproved and far-side feet are partly occluded. No angle-transition video has been submitted.

bookOnly.reviewNotes: Native artifact review: the prompt requested a white background, but the output is black. Transparency was not preserved, and red/yellow fringes are visible under the feet and around edges. Poor handling of the RGBA input is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. Limb motion looks more natural to the reviewer, but correct four-paw gait, seamless closure, and production readiness remain uncertified. The unedited native output is shown; no background removal, fringe repair, or normalization has been applied. No further generation is authorized.
